@rateLimit.summary: Declares a per-field rate limit (max requests in a time window, optionally keyed by identity and arguments).

authors.intro: Import with `@link(url: "https://specs.graphql-mesh.dev/rate-limit/v0.1", import: ["@rateLimit"])` and `@composeDirective` so composition keeps the directive. Annotate fields that should be throttled. Without a conforming enforcer the annotation is inert.

implementers.intro: On each annotated field resolve, compute an identity key (viewer + optional `identityArgs` + optional array-length cost), then allow or reject according to `max` / `window`. On reject, return a GraphQL field error using `message` when set.
implementers.compose: Preserve `@rateLimit` and its args on the Supergraph.
implementers.runtime: Enforce before or around the field resolver. Track counts per identity key for the window; exceeding `max` fails the field.
implementers.validation: When enforcing, require a positive `max` and a parseable `window`. `identityArgs` / `arrayLengthField`, when present, must name existing field arguments.

max.defaults: Optional Int; required for enforcement in practice.
max.constraints: Positive maximum requests (or tokens) per window.
max.authors: How many allowed hits in the window.
max.implementers: Ceiling for the counter / token bucket.
max.validation: If present, must be a positive integer.

window.implementers: Parse to a time-to-live / window length.
window.validation: If present, must parse as a duration (e.g. `1s`, `1m`).

message.authors: Client-facing text when the limit is hit.
message.implementers: Attach to the GraphQL error on reject.

identityArgs.constraints: Argument names included in the rate-limit identity key.
identityArgs.authors: Scope limits per argument values (e.g. per search query).
identityArgs.implementers: Include these arg values in the identity hash alongside viewer identity.

arrayLengthField.constraints: Argument name whose array length multiplies cost.
arrayLengthField.authors: Charge N tokens for an array input of length N.
arrayLengthField.implementers: Multiply token cost by that argument’s array length.
